<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Register or re-register a station"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/stations"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Creates a station with the given capability set, or — if `stationId` already exists — replaces its capability set (e.g. recertifying a station for a new capability). This is deliberately idempotent by client-supplied id: re-registering the same `stationId` upserts rather than erroring or duplicating, which is what closes the pull-dispatch gap for HTTP-only smoke testing (without this endpoint there is no way to create a station over HTTP, so `claim-next` against a freshly started server always 404s).

Must be non-empty: the API treats \"\" as a missing field and rejects it with 400.\n","example":"station-1"},"capabilities":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"items":{"type":"string","nullable":true,"description":"A null item is accepted and treated as an empty capability string (Go's JSON decoding cannot distinguish them).\n","example":"pick"}},"locationCode":{"type":"string","nullable":true,"description":"Optional facility-layout LocationCode identifying where this station physically sits (ADR-0024).
